about: Where an objective is done, or where the arrow leads for a quest's giver or ender, anchored on the quest (never a line). forge-writer applies each record to the guides it writes, every build; forge data check-corrections checks this file; FORGE.md, Fixing a generated guide, has the format. objective: the objective's number (as in `quest Q.N`), "giver" or "ender". at: { map, x, y, frame }; path: { map, frame, points } for a target that walks a road (a loop of gotos before the goal); write: true gives the objective its own goal line from the data before the quest's bare complete. A record with faction (Alliance or Horde) holds for that side's routes only. Each record has a note, its source ({ kind, ref }, the kinds of forever-db/README.md) and its issue or pr.

places.note: Blisters on the Land: the Fen Creepers are hunted along the Wetlands' river and the Sundown Marsh waterways, not the few by Rethiel the Greenwarden. In game the reporter ran out of creepers at the spot by the giver and found enough at 24.46,33.18 (#610). Players' recordings (2026-11-09: 9 people, 101 kills) show the creepers killed all along the river from 48 to 35 (y 25-35) as well as at 24-26: the arrow now walks the river east to west from Einar Stonegrip's road, ending at the reporter's cluster, instead of crossing the zone to 24.46,33.18 and back to Rethiel (1,067 + 1,335 yd).

source.ref: #610: the reporter's spot, 24.46,33.18
